profile.title: Ashutosh Upadhyay, Advocate
profile.paragraph1: Ashutosh Upadhyay is an Advocate associated with the Civil Siddharthnagar Bar Association (C.S.B.A.) and provides legal consultation and representation in Siddharthnagar and Naugarh, Uttar Pradesh.
profile.paragraph2: His professional work includes litigation, legal research, interpretation of statutes, drafting, procedural preparation, case analysis and legal representation across a range of civil and criminal matters.

delhi.title: Judicial Preparation - Delhi
delhi.description: Undertook judicial-services preparation at Rahul's IAS, Mukherjee Nagar, Delhi, with exposure to legal research, statutory interpretation, procedural law and legal analysis.

lucknow.title: Lucknow Bench Exposure
lucknow.description: Gained professional exposure at the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court under CSC Mayankar Singh, Advocate (Senior), including service matters, contract matters, mediation and procedural practice.

civil.title: Civil Practice
civil.description: Developed civil-practice experience under Sri Gangaram Pandey, including property disputes, land disputes, injunctions, declarations, succession, NI Act matters, arbitration, commercial matters and consumer disputes.

criminal.title: Criminal Practice
criminal.description: Gained practical understanding of criminal litigation through guidance from Sri Suresh Singh, Sri Sanjay Srivastava and Sri Gajendranath Pandey, Advocates.

approach.title: Research, Analysis and Preparation
approach.description: The practice approach focuses on understanding facts, studying applicable law, analysing legal issues, preparing the matter carefully and presenting the lawful case before the appropriate forum.

note.title: Legal Matters Depend on Their Individual Facts
note.description: The information on this page describes broad areas of practice. The legal remedy, forum and procedure applicable to a matter depend on its individual facts, documents and applicable law.

1.title: Civil Matters
1.description: Civil suits, injunctions, declarations, ejectment, recovery, execution, SCC matters, tenancy, specific performance, succession, arbitration, land and property disputes, partition, title, possession and related civil matters.

2.title: Criminal Matters
2.description: Professional assistance in sessions trials, warrant trials, summons trials, summary trials and other substantive and procedural criminal-law matters.

3.title: POCSO Cases
3.description: Professional assistance and legal representation in proceedings arising under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

4.title: Matrimonial & Family Matters
4.description: Matrimonial disputes, maintenance proceedings, domestic violence proceedings, family disputes and related matrimonial and family-law matters.

5.title: NDPS Cases
5.description: Professional assistance and legal representation in proceedings arising under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985.

6.title: Negotiable Instruments / NI Act
6.description: Cheque-related matters, cheque bounce cases and other proceedings arising under the Negotiable Instruments Act.

7.title: Revenue Matters
7.description: Partition, map partition, declaratory suits, boundary disputes, correction of revenue records, mutation, Khatauni, demarcation, injunctions and other proceedings before revenue authorities.

8.title: Motor Accident Claims (MACT)
8.description: Representation before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal in accident compensation, injury, death, property damage, insurance and related legally maintainable claims.

9.title: Government Authority Matters
9.description: Legal assistance concerning unlawful or arbitrary actions of police, revenue departments, district administration and other State or Central Government authorities, including RTI and accountability-related matters.

disclaimer.title: Legal Disclaimer
disclaimer.paragraph1: The information provided on this website is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice.
disclaimer.paragraph2: Viewing or using this website, submitting an enquiry, or booking an appointment does not, by itself, create an advocate-client relationship between you and Advocate Ashutosh Upadhyay.
disclaimer.paragraph3: The applicable law, procedure and outcome of any legal matter depend on its own specific facts and documents. You should seek advice appropriate to your own circumstances before acting on any information found on this website.
disclaimer.paragraph4: The website assistant (chatbot) is an automated tool that provides general website information only. It does not provide legal advice and does not represent the advocate.
disclaimer.paragraph5: Communication sent through this website - including the enquiry form, appointment form, email or WhatsApp - is not end-to-end encrypted and carries the general privacy and security limitations of electronic communication. Please avoid sharing highly confidential information until you have spoken with the advocate directly.
